base_template.name: Bootstrap Base
base_template.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <style>
      {{css}}
    </style>
    <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.0.2/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet" integrity="sha384-EVSTQN3/azprG1Anm3QDgpJLIm9Nao0Yz1ztcQTwFspd3yD65VohhpuuCOmLASjC" crossorigin="anonymous">
  </head>
  <body>
    {% block content %}{% endblock %}
  </body>
</html>

template.name: Memory Check Alert Percentage (html)
template.template_variables:
data_sources:
  checkResults:
    model: checkresult
    limit: 5000
    only:
      - id
      - agent_id
      - assigned_check_id
      - status
      - alert_severity
      - last_run
      - fail_count
      - outage_history
      - history
  checks:
    model: check
    only:
      - id
      - name
      - check_type
      - agent_id
      - policy_id
  agents:
    model: agent
    only:
      - id
      - hostname
      - client
      - site
  target_check_id:
    friendly_name: Memory check ID
    description: Numeric ID of the memory threshold check to evaluate
